# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux architecture support**

## Highlights

The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.159.0 release drops Linux x86 native assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Migrate Linux x86 applications before upgrading** — Linux x86 native builds and their NuGet package entries are being removed, following upstream .NET infrastructure changes. Applications targeting 32-bit Linux x86 must move to a supported architecture before upgrading. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
